# GetREALISM

> A science-inspired resource for mastering realistic drawing and painting through evidence-based techniques, color theory, and observational skill development.

GetREALISM is founded by Sonia, a realistic painter who combines scientific principles with practical art instruction. The site covers foundational drawing and painting methods, advanced techniques using golden ratio and chiaroscuro, and detailed tutorials on materials, color mixing, and surface preparation for oil painting.

## Key Topics

- Realistic Drawing
- Oil Painting
- Chiaroscuro
- Skin Tone Mixing
- Light and Shadow
- Golden Ratio
- Canvas Preparation
- Observational Drawing
- Color Theory
- Shading and Blending
- Painting Techniques
- Drawing Techniques
- Portrait Painting
- Science-Based Learning
- Linseed Oil

## Core Guides

- [Master Fine Motor Skills for Realistic Drawing & Painting](https://www.getrealism.com): GetREALISM homepage: master realistic drawing & painting with science-inspired techniques.
- [Science-Backed Drawing Tips for Realistic Art](https://www.getrealism.com/drawing.php): Core drawing guide covering observation, shading, proportions & realistic techniques.
- [Science-Inspired Painting Tips for Realistic Mastery](https://www.getrealism.com/painting.php): Core painting guide with layering, observation & perceptual skill development.
- [Meet Sonia: Realistic Painter & Science-Inspired Art Guide](https://www.getrealism.com/about-the-artist-sonia.php): About page introducing Sonia, realistic painter & GetREALISM creator.

## Drawing Techniques & Fundamentals

- [How to Shade for Realistic Drawings: Layer Shadows, Preserve Lights, and Blend Mid-Tones](https://www.getrealism.com/how-to-make-drawing-three-dimensional.php): Tutorial on shading techniques using pencil & charcoal for three-dimensional realism.
- [Pencil Drawing Tips for Realism: Sharpening, Hardness, Paper, and Shading Techniques](https://www.getrealism.com/pencil-drawing.php): Pencil drawing tutorial covering sharpening, graphite grades & realistic shading.
- [Realistic Drawing Tips: Proportions, Straight Lines, Shadow Shapes, No Outlines & Mid-Tone Blending](https://www.getrealism.com/drawing-realistic-art.php): Drawing guide covering proportions, shadow shapes & mid-tone blending techniques.

## Oil Painting: Materials & Preparation

- [Essential Oil Painting Supplies for Beginners: Best Materials, Surfaces, Paints, Brushes, and Mediums](https://www.getrealism.com/oil-painting-supplies.php): Beginner guide to essential oil painting supplies including paints & brushes.
- [How to Start Oil Painting: Essential Supplies – Artist-Grade Paints, Surfaces, Brushes, Linseed Oil & Studio Basics](https://www.getrealism.com/what-materials-do-i-need-to-start-oil-painting.php): Beginner guide to starting oil painting with artist-grade supplies & studio setup.
- [Best Oil Painting Brushes: Types, Materials, Sizes, and Recommendations for Beginners](https://www.getrealism.com/what-are-the-essential-brushes-for-oil-painting.php): Guide to selecting oil painting brushes by type, material & size for beginners.
- [How to Prepare a Canvas for Oil Painting: Gesso Priming, Sanding, and Toning Tips](https://www.getrealism.com/preparing-a-canvas-for-oil-painting.php): Guide to canvas preparation with gesso priming & surface conditioning for oil.
- [How to Make Oil Paint Dry Faster: Safe Methods Using Heat, Thin Layers & Mediums](https://www.getrealism.com/how-to-make-oil-paint-dry-faster.php): Tutorial on accelerating oil paint drying using heat, layers & mediums safely.

## Color Mixing & Skin Tones

- [How to Mix Realistic Skin Tones in Oil Paint: Color Combinations, Temperature, and Techniques](https://www.getrealism.com/skin-tone-oil-paint.php): Tutorial on mixing realistic skin tones in oil with color temperature techniques.
- [How to Mix Skin Tones in Oil Paint: Base Color, Tints, Temperature Adjustments & Shadows](https://www.getrealism.com/how-to-make-skin-tone-with-paint.php): Step-by-step guide to mixing flesh tones using Venetian Red & Raw Sienna base.
- [How to Mix Lifelike Skin Tones in Oil Paint: Colors, Techniques & Subtle Adjustments](https://www.getrealism.com/what-colours-make-skin-tones.php): Guide to mixing realistic skin tones using color theory & temperature shifts.

## Advanced Techniques & Composition

- [Chiaroscuro Painting: How Bold Light & Dark Makes Art Easier, Faster & More Dramatic](https://www.getrealism.com/chiaroscuro.php): Tutorial on chiaroscuro technique using dramatic light-dark contrast for impact.
- [How to Use the Golden Ratio in Art: Composition Guide with Canvas Calculator Method](https://www.getrealism.com/golden-ratio-calculator.php): Composition guide applying golden ratio & divine proportion to canvas design.
- [Unusual Art Techniques & Hacks: Math, Nature & Science for Realism](https://www.getrealism.com/more-art-techniques-and-skills.php): Advanced art techniques guide covering golden ratio, natural pigments & DIY supplies.
